## Problem

What problem does this change address?

## Approach

What changed, and why is this the smallest useful change?

## Evidence and verification

How was the change checked?

## Safety and inclusion

What are the privacy, consent, abuse, bias, accessibility, or legal implications?

## Checklist

- [ ] I did not include secrets, credentials, or private personal data.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I added appropriate tests or explained why they are not yet applicable.
